note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). One supplied datum (the value on the object's state tag) is substituted and only its dependent marks change; nothing is valued and no validity, liability, compensation or outcome is inferred. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision 2026-09-27, LAW-0700: stress record rows capped so the 1:1 subject reaches >= 0.20 of the frame height (standing stress rule, AUTHORING item 20; subject legibility treated as a floor). Rendered before the cap (5 entries, 2 alternatives, 2 labelled links, 2 losses): 1:1 vase 0.125 of the frame height (0.166 labels hidden). Capping the record rows alone did not reach the floor (2 entries with both links still drawn: 1:1 vase 0.125, the band of notes kept the stacked area full), so the cap also takes the alternatives and links to one each. After the cap (3 entries, 1 alternative, 1 labelled link, 2 losses; every text at its near-maximum length): 1:1 vase 0.201 at 20 px text (0.234 labels hidden); 9:16 0.302, 16:9 0.424. Every count stays >= the baseline (2 entries, 0 alternatives, 0 links, 1 loss) and every field longer than the baseline.
